# `mem` standard library

The `mem` module provides unified, explicit memory management:
low-level byte operations, regional bump arenas, and fixed-capacity object pools.

```dva run
#use mem
```

## Low-level memory utilities

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mem::copy` | `Addr, Addr, Int => ()` | Copies `bytes` count from source to destination |
| `mem::move` | `Addr, Addr, Int => ()` | Copies `bytes` count with support for overlap |
| `mem::zero` | `Addr, Int => ()` | Fills memory range with zeros |
| `mem::set` | `Addr, Int, Int => ()` | Fills memory range with specified byte value |
| `mem::align_forward` | `Addr, Int => Addr` | Advances address to meet alignment requirement |
| `mem::is_aligned` | `Addr, Int => <>` | Checks whether address satisfies alignment |

## Regional bump arenas

Arenas provide allocation without per-object free overhead. All allocations
within an arena are freed simultaneously when the arena is reset or destroyed.

```dva run
#type Arena (raw: Addr, cap: Int)
#type ArenaStats (bytes_allocated: Int, num_chunks: Int, cap: Int)
```

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mem::arena` | `Int => Arena` | Creates an arena with initial chunk capacity (bytes) |
| `mem::arena_default` | `() => Arena` | Creates an arena with default 64 MB chunk capacity |
| `mem::alloc` | `Arena, Int => Addr` | Allocates uninitialized memory of given byte size |
| `mem::reset` | `Arena => ()` | Rewinds arena offset to zero, retaining chunks |
| `mem::destroy` | `Arena => ()` | Frees all backing chunks and arena descriptor |
| `mem::stats` | `Arena => ArenaStats` | Retrieves allocation metrics and chunk counts |
| `mem::with` | `Arena, (() => ()) => ()` | Runs action with arena set as ambient allocator |

```dva run
#use mem

ar = mem::arena(1024)
buf = mem::alloc(ar, 256)
// ... use buf ...
mem::destroy(ar)
```

## Fixed-capacity object pools

Pools manage uniform, fixed-size element allocations with $O(1)$ allocation and deallocation.

```dva run
#type Pool (buffer: Addr, free_stack: Addr, active: Addr, state: Addr,
   elem_size: Int, capacity: Int)
```

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mem::pool` | `Int, Int => Pool` | Creates pool: `mem::pool(elem_size, capacity)` |
| `mem::pool_alloc` | `Pool => < Addr \| >` | Allocates slot: `<+ Addr +>` or `<-->` on full |
| `mem::pool_free` | `Pool, Addr => <>` | Frees slot: `<+>` on success, `<->` on error |
| `mem::pool_count` | `Pool => Int` | Number of currently active allocated slots |
| `mem::pool_capacity` | `Pool => Int` | Maximum capacity of the pool |
| `mem::pool_for_each` | `Pool, (Addr => ()) => ()` | Iterates over each active allocated slot |
| `mem::pool_destroy` | `Pool => ()` | Releases pool memory buffer |

```dva run
#use mem
#use io

// Create pool with element size 16 bytes and capacity of 4 slots:
p = mem::pool(16, 4)

io::out $ mem::pool_capacity(p) // 4
io::out $ mem::pool_count(p)    // 0

slot = mem::pool_alloc(p)
slot
   | addr =>
      @[addr] = 42
      io::out $ @[addr Int]
      freed = mem::pool_free(p, addr)
      freed | io::out("freed") | io::out("invalid")
   | io::out("pool exhausted")

mem::pool_destroy(p)
```
